title: Fluid Systems
description: Fluid Systems (fuel, hydraulics and pneumatics) as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are fluid system schematics and line sizes defined?
Are design pressures, temperatures and fluids stated for each line?
Are fluid system safety hazards (leaks, fire, contamination) identified?
Are pressure drop, surge and drainage assessed for the preliminary routing?
Are line supports, flexible sections and expansion allowances defined?
Are fluid-zone segregation and drainage requirements applied?
Are leak check and proof pressure test requirements defined for every joint?
Are fittings, seals and torque values specified on the released definitions?
Is cleanliness and contamination control specified for assembly?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
